items.name: Wrightsville Beach Sloop All Over Print Tote Bag
items.alt: Navy tote bag printed edge to edge with white sailboats on teal waves, resting on the sand beside a towel and straw hat at Wrightsville Beach, shown as an illustrative image
items.meta: A printed tote with a navy sloop pattern running seam to seam across the whole bag. A Wrightsville Beach carry-all for the Carolina coast.
facts: Navy or beige cotton webbing, solid color
100% spun polyester with a laminate lining, spot clean
Sailboat pattern printed edge to edge on the bag body, not embroidered
